summary.en: A local-first block Markdown notes app for macOS, Windows, and Linux — no sign-up, permanently free.
summary.zh-CN: 本地优先的块编辑 Markdown 笔记：不用注册，打开就能写，支持 Mac、Windows 和 Linux，永久免费。

description.en: Block stores notes as plain Markdown on your computer and stays fast on long documents. It includes typography, version history, a quick-note window, and AI edits you review before they are written, plus optional sync, image hosting, and migration extensions. Open source under Apache 2.0.
description.zh-CN: Block 把笔记以普通 Markdown 存在自己电脑里，长文也能秒开。内置排版、版本找回、速记小窗和 AI 改稿（先预览再写入），并可按需安装同步、图床和迁移扩展。源码以 Apache 2.0 开源。
